title: hf-data-agent: a Hugging Face backed RAG data agent
description: hf-data-agent is a Python research-software prototype for a retrieval-augmented data agent. It routes UI, HTTP API, MCP, and Slack entrypoints through one orchestrator; builds its knowledge base offline; queries warehouse and platform tools live; and supports mock, local Hugging Face Transformers, hosted Hugging Face Inference, and OpenAI-compatible model backends.
notes: This record archives the source code released from GitHub. Local secrets, virtual environments, generated caches, SQLite databases, and generated vector stores are excluded by the repository ignore rules.
